Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game, holding their resources, cards, flags, and identity.

All card additions go through addCharacterCard(CharacterCard) or addBuildingCard(BuildingCard), which fire the card's side-effects. For persistence restoration, use restoreState(int, int, List, List, List, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, int, boolean, int) instead to bypass side-effects.

    • restoreState

      public void restoreState(int nuggets, int prestige, List<CharacterCard> chars, List<BuildingCard> buildings, List<InventionType> inventions, boolean doublePointForBuilder, boolean doublePointForRituals, boolean noMalusForRituals, boolean extraThreeStars, boolean extraFoodOnTurnOrder, boolean extraCard, boolean setToCheck, int setNumberForExtraFood, boolean inventorsToCheck, int foodDiscountFromBuildings)
      Directly restores all state fields from a persisted snapshot. Does NOT call onAddedToPlayer or any other side-effects; all flags are already in their final form inside the snapshot.
      Parameters:
      nuggets - food count to restore
      prestige - prestige points to restore
      chars - character cards to restore
      buildings - building cards to restore
      inventions - invention types to restore
      doublePointForBuilder - double-point-for-Builder flag
      doublePointForRituals - double-point-for-Rituals flag
      noMalusForRituals - no-malus-for-Rituals flag
      extraThreeStars - extra-three-stars flag
      extraFoodOnTurnOrder - extra-food-on-turn-order flag
      extraCard - extra-card flag
      setToCheck - set-completion tracking flag
      setNumberForExtraFood - number of complete sets already counted
      inventorsToCheck - Inventor synergy tracking flag
      foodDiscountFromBuildings - accumulated building food discount
